{{Top|leg}}
[[File:MonCalamari-CrewmanUniform.png|250px|thumb|Mon Calamari crewman]]
A '''Mon Calamari Crewman uniform''' was a uniform worn by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The uniforms were similar to that worn by officers like [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], but in tan and gray colors.<ref name="WEG">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Many of these crewman wore the uniform on [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> including [[Thaneespi/Legends|Thaneespi]] and [[Verrack/Legends|Verrack]], during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCG Thaneespi">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=First Officer Thaneespi}}</ref><ref name="CCG Verrack">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Verrack}}</ref>
